nom: Benefit Cosmetics The POREfessional Get Unblocked Makeup-Removing Cleansing Oil

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes makeup without leaving greasy residue, and some note their skin looks less oily or that blackheads/sebaceous filaments visibly improve.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it does not strip or dehydrate their skin, feels hydrating and nourishing, and is well suited to dryness including dryness that developed with age.
segments.combination: One reviewer with dry-combination skin reports it removed makeup and helped oiliness with no reaction.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no irritation, burning, or breakouts even with fragrance present, while one explicitly warns it cannot be used on consecutive days without her face becoming too irritated and another lost eyelashes.
segments.mature: Older reviewers (one 66, one describing aging skin) report it moisturizes drier, aging skin and one credits it with clearing hard bump-like blemishes that appeared with age.

concerns.aging: Two mature reviewers report visible improvement (smaller pores, disappearance of hard wart-like bumps) and moisturizing benefit for skin that had become drier with age.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it does not dry out or strip skin and leaves it feeling hydrated/nourished; no reviewer reports increased dryness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers broadly report no stripping and a soft, non-greasy after-feel; one sensitive-skin reviewer is an exception, describing irritation with repeated daily use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report visibly clearer, smaller-looking pores and fewer blackheads/sebaceous filaments after regular use; one reviewer instead reports getting more pimples after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or blackhead-prone skin generally report no new breakouts and describe clearer pores; against this, one reviewer noticed increased pimples and one reviewer with eyelash loss found the product ineffective and damaging.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers describe the product as leaving skin less oily and non-greasy after use, with no reports of increased oiliness.

extraits.texte: Poor performance since it doesn't fully removes face and eye makeup. I wear waterproof mascara and the oil didn't break it down, and even worse, it made my eyelashes to fall. I didn't rub it or was aggressive whatsoever, so I was surprised to see that outcome. The balms from Clinique or The Body Shop are much more gentle and more effective.

extraits.titre: Again, I really wanted to love this…
extraits.texte: I received the deluxe trial versions of this new line and have been using the products religiously for a solid week, as Benefit recommended. Like I've said in my other reviews I really wanted to love this but it just wasn't for me. I love how lightweight it is, and it did well for my sensitive skin. Didn't dry out my skin at all which was nice. I would use this as a lightweight face wash maybe? But definitely not as a makeup remover. It was subpar in removing my foundation, and did absolutely nothing to remove the waterproof makeup on my lids, lashes and brows.

extraits.titre: Incredible product - not for the sensitive of skin
extraits.texte: I am a sensitive skin girly. I loved the pre-cleanse based on the smell and feel of it. And it did exactly what it was supposed to do - remove all the makeup from my face. Much better than wipes! However, I cannot use this product multiple days in a row or my face gets too irritated. :( Complimentary from Benefit Cosmetics

I am 66 & in my youth had very oily skin. As I aged my skin became dryer & I wanted a cleanser to help moisturize. This is the best I've found. I use as directed and it removes all makeup perfectly, even my mascara. Has never irritated my skin.

Recently I was gifted by benefit The POREfessional Get Unblocked Oil Cleanser and be the first to try their newest POREfessional Skincare Collection, launched in mid-February 2023. My dry skin loves this cleansing oil. It melts away all those waterproof makeup, even the sunscreen. I love double cleansing my skin in my routine, and this cleanser works like magic. It cleans effortlessly. Just a gentle rub is all you need. It's very runny, and a little goes a long way. The scent is so fresh and pleasant. I love it! It's suitable for all skin types, especially dry ones like mine.

This Cleansing oil removed my makeup and helped my oily skin. I have dry combination skin and this did not cause any reaction. The scent is faint and not overwhelming. This was gifted by Benefit Cosmetics.

extraits.titre: Must have for anyone who uses sunscreen daily
extraits.texte: This is a very good cleanser. I use sunscreen everyday because I live in Arizona. If I don't have a cleanser that really gets into my pores and clears it out I break out so terribly. This product really makes my face feel so clean! When I have make up on this always takes it all off it's amazing
